subject: Warming and Cooling Center Exploration
overview: The committee met to discuss options and regional models for establishing an overnight warming and cooling center for unhoused adults in Medford, and reviewed upcoming priorities on the committee's 2024–2025 governing agenda. The committee voted to keep the warming center resolution in committee and voted to receive and place on file the governing agenda review.

items.title: Warming and Cooling Center for Adults Experiencing Homelessness
items.summary: The committee heard presentations from Malden Warming Center director Pastor Jerry Whetstone and city health, social work, and planning staff regarding regional homelessness services, facility requirements, funding constraints, and potential collaboration before voting to keep the paper in committee.

items.title: 2024–2025 Council Governing Agenda Review
items.summary: Councilors reviewed the committee's upcoming docket items—including wildlife feeding regulations, vegetation overgrowth enforcement, healthcare privacy protections, and annual surveillance reporting—and voted to receive and place the review on file.
